instruction: Enable Thunderbird to download and store offline copies of all IMAP emails.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to enable offline message storage for IMAP accounts in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks that the preference 'mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores' is set to true in the prefs.js file. This is similar to the original task in that it requires changing Thunderbird mail server settings through the preferences interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the preference 'mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores' which semantically verifies enabling offline IMAP message storage
Expected value (true) is correct for enabling the feature
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird and waits 0.5s to ensure prefs.js is written to disk before verification
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the prefs.js file from VM
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) properly parses prefs.js using regex and JSON, then verifies the preference value
Metric handles None return from getter correctly by returning 0.0
Complete coverage: the single preference check fully verifies the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Static warning about type mismatch (str vs Union) is overly cautious - the metric already handles None properly at runtime

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
